corollary1.statement: |gluing| is an integer perfect square iff every det(L_i) is a perfect square
corollary1.W33_instance: |gluing|=2^18*3^10*5 has v_5=1 so is not a perfect square

corollary2.statement: If any det(L_i)>1 then the eigenlattice direct sum is a proper sublattice of Z^n, witnessing non-trivial gluing

theorem: Two corollaries of the Pass 829 discriminant identity are verified exactly for W(3,3). Corollary 1: the gluing group order is a perfect square iff every eigenlattice determinant is a perfect square; for W(3,3) the 5-adic valuation 1 witnesses this is not the case. Corollary 2: the existence of any det(L_i)>1 certifies non-trivial gluing; all three W(3,3) eigenlattice determinants exceed 1.
boundary: These corollaries apply under the unimodular ambient and saturatedness hypotheses of Pass 829. They do not address the definiteness of the E8 lift (the paper open residual).
